name: After Hours #3 — Convenience Fog
description: Fog against the automatic doors. The coffee is still too hot and the magazines have nobody to sell to. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 3 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 3-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
